formulas.name: SaveClioAddresses
formulas.expression:
["ClioAddresses.length > 0
  ? {
    id: ClioAddresses[0].id,
    name: ClioAddresses[0].name || "Work",
    street: StreetAddress1 + (StreetAddress2 ? ("\n" + StreetAddress2) : ""),
    city: City,
    province: State.Abbrev,
    postal_code: Zip,
  }
  : (StreetAddress1 || StreetAddress2 || City || State || Zip)
    ? {
      name: "Work",
      street: StreetAddress1 + (StreetAddress2 ? ("\n" + StreetAddress2) : ""),
      city: City,
      province: State.Abbrev,
      postal_code: Zip,
    }
    : null","ClioAddresses.slice(1)"]

formulas.name: SaveClioEmails
formulas.expression:
["Email && (ClioEmails|any:primary)
  ? {
    id: (ClioEmails|find:primary).id,
    name: (ClioEmails|find:primary).name || "Work",
    address: Email,
    primary: true,
  }
  : Email
    ? {
      name: "Work",
      address: Email,
      primary: true,
    }
    : null","ClioEmails|filter:!primary"]
